title: Signature
description: Read the document, then sign it electronically.
gone: This signature request cannot be found or is no longer available.
refused: The action could not be completed.

state.COMPLETED: Everyone has signed. The sealed document is in the requester's documents.
state.DECLINED: This request is closed: someone declined to sign.
state.signed: You signed this document. Thank you.
state.declined: You declined to sign this document.
state.waiting: It is not your turn to sign yet. You will get an email.

consent.title: Sign electronically
consent.text: By continuing, you agree to sign this document electronically. Your signature has the same value as a signature on paper. If you prefer paper, say so.
consent.paperSent: We told the requester that you prefer paper.

code.title: Confirm who you are
code.text: We send a six-digit code to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
code.label: Six-digit code

sign.title: Sign
sign.text: Type your name to sign. You can also draw your signature.
sign.name: Your name
sign.confirmVariation: I confirm this name is mine (account: {name}).

invalid.name: Type your name (2 to 120 characters).
invalid.drawing: The drawn signature is not valid.

refusals.closed: This link has expired or the request is closed.
refusals.notYourTurn: It is not your turn to sign yet.
refusals.otpRate: Too many codes requested. Try again later.
refusals.otpExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
refusals.otpBlocked: Code blocked. Ask for a new code.
refusals.otpRequired: Confirm your identity with the code sent by email.
refusals.consentRequired: Accept to sign electronically to continue.
refusals.hashMismatch: This document has changed since it was sent. It cannot be signed. We told the requester.
refusals.nameVariation: This name differs from yours. Confirm the variation to sign.
refusals.batchNotAllowed: These documents need a code: sign them one at a time.
refusals.drawingInvalid: The drawn signature is not valid.
refusals.verifyRate: Too many checks. Try again later.

verify.title: Check a document
verify.description: Choose a PDF file: its fingerprint is computed in your browser and the file is not uploaded. We only say whether it is a document sealed by Escalia.
verify.found: Document sealed by Escalia: "{title}", completed on {date}, signed by {signers} person(s).
verify.notFound: This file is not a document sealed by Escalia, or it was changed.
verify.error: The check could not be made. Try again later.
